app.name: VI Line Test
app.short_description: Probe for more than 1023 VI lines per field
app.long_description: Reads back which bits exist in every VI register, runs rasters with the bits above the documented line-count fields set and measures the frame length on the beam counter, and tries merging two progressive fields into one frame by switching off the vsync between them. Includes a 480p made from two merged 240-line fields to check on any 480p display. Logs to vilinetest.txt.
